help.title: Help
help.sub: How to use the program. The same text is in «How to use.docx».
help.s1:
1. «Anonymize» → drop the files (Word, PDF, scans, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, TXT, photos).
  2. Press «Anonymize (N)». The bar shows the stage and the time left; «Stop» stops after the current file.
  3. Open «Preview»: labels are coloured, all values are on the right. Remove an extra mask with «Do not mask»; select a missed value in the text → «Mask».
  4. «Download» or «Download all (ZIP)» - the file names contain labels only. «Copy the instruction for the neural network» and paste it before the document in the chat.

One person gets one label in every file of the session. After any edit the files are rebuilt by themselves.
help.s2:
«Restore data» → choose the session where you anonymized. The neural network reply - as text («Text»: paste it and press «Restore data», then «Copy») or as a file («File»).

Highlight: green - restored exactly, yellow - the case of a name was chosen (check it), red - the label is not in this session (check that the right session is selected). The initial form of an entry (nominative case) is the base for inflection in new text.
help.s3_t: What a session and the Dictionary are
help.s3:
A session is the files anonymized together and their replacement table. It is deleted whole after the term in Settings (7, 30 or 90 days) or at once with a button - without a bin: this is personal data. After deletion, data cannot be restored into the neural network reply.

The Dictionary works in every session: «Always mask» and «Never mask». A value gets there only when you choose «always». The Dictionary keeps values without a term until you delete them; deleting a session does not touch it.
help.s4_t: What to do if the program missed something
help.s4:
Completeness comes first: look through every file before sending. The yellow line «Check» leads to suspicious places. Select a missed value in «Preview» → «Mask», or add it in «Replacement table» → «Add manually». If the value is written differently (an abbreviation, another case) - «Another spelling…».

Scans and photos are painted over by the recognized text - data cannot be restored into them.
help.s5: Everything works on this computer, nothing goes to the internet. Data is in the folder «Application Support/Anonymizer», the log - in «Logs/Anonymizer»; the log has no values and no file names (except the diagnostic mode until restart).
help.s6:
The neural network is an optional local check (Ollama). Switch it on in Settings → «More» with «Use the neural network»: it checks what was found and chooses the case in doubtful places. By the measurements of version 3.4 it adds almost nothing, and the work is slower.

If another program uses the GPU, the window asks: wait in the queue, start now, on the processor (very slow) or cancel. The model is installed with ollama pull qwen3.5:9b.
